description: Complete named-channel and tracing workflows using canonical franken_engine diagnostics_channel. Use scripts/project_compat_runner.py --corpus fixtures/compatibility/projects/diagnostics.corpus.json with real --bin/--node/--bun executables. Reference/host checks do not establish native module identity, accounting or ecosystem parity. Store objects in this cohort are user-supplied synchronous scopes, not an AsyncLocalStorage implementation.

cases.description: A package conditionally publishes projected records to an independently loaded subscriber; removing that subscriber stops later delivery.
Conditional ESM exports and a core reexport connect a package promise trace to external observers, preserving successful results and a falsy rejection.

files.main.mjs: import fs from 'node:fs';import {channel} from './observe.mjs';import {work} from '@fixture/traced-work';const events=[];for(const name of ['start','end','asyncStart','asyncEnd','error'])channel('tracing:fixture.work:'+name).subscribe(c=>events.push(name+':'+c.id));(async function(){const value=await work(21,'ok');let same=false;try{await work(-1,'bad');}catch(error){same=error===false;}fs.writeFileSync('trace.json',JSON.stringify({value,same,events})+'\n');console.log('ESM_DIAGNOSTICS',value,same,events.length);})();
import {tracingChannel} from 'diagnostics_channel';const trace=tracingChannel('fixture.work');export function work(value,id){return trace.tracePromise(async function(){await Promise.resolve();if(value<0)throw false;return value*2;},{id});}

cases.description: A callback package retains its immediate ticket and callback receiver, while the observer binds a user-supplied synchronous store around actual continuation and file output.
An initially unobserved package returns its original promise; after subscription, two operations settle in reverse order without mixing trace contexts.

files.main.cjs: const fs=require('node:fs'),dc=require('diagnostics_channel'),work=require('./work.cjs');const original=Promise.resolve(7),same=work.trace(original,{id:'silent'})===original;const events=[];const trace=dc.tracingChannel('fixture.concurrent');for(const name of ['start','end','asyncStart','asyncEnd'])trace[name].subscribe(c=>events.push(name+':'+c.id));let finishA,finishB;const a={id:'a'},b={id:'b'};const pa=work.trace(new Promise(resolve=>finishA=resolve),a);const pb=work.trace(new Promise(resolve=>finishB=resolve),b);(async function(){finishB(2);await pb;finishA(1);await pa;fs.writeFileSync('concurrent.json',JSON.stringify({same,a:a.result,b:b.result,events})+'\n');console.log('CONCURRENT_DIAGNOSTICS',same,a.result,b.result,events.length);})();
